# The denominator in the feedback form

Seven visitors said the draft display was clear. Eleven walked past without stopping, and four left before seeing the feedback table. Reporting seven positive responses would be accurate and misleading. Count who encountered the invitation to respond. [[Field methods]] needs a denominator more than a more sophisticated chart. The harbour archive is not a referendum on whether the museum is welcoming.
